name: Apollo Justice Case 5 : Turnabout Substitution
source:
The game is set shortly after "Turnabout Succession" and intends to be Apollo Justice's "Rise from the Ashes".

When the city's most famous judge gets arrested on suspicion of murdering an infamous serial killer, he has no one to turn to but rookie attorney Apollo Justice.
But is he up to the task? Can he find the truth on his own? And, above all, can he face it?
Prepare for a mind-bogglingly intricate plot filled with suspense and unsuspected twists!

[From [url=http://forums.court-records.net/games/apollo-justice-case-demo-released-2h30-gameplay-t13200.html]Court-Records.net[/url]]
translation:
遊戲發生在《繼承的逆轉》後不久，意在成為王泥喜法介版的《復甦的逆轉》。

全市最著名的法官因涉嫌謀殺一名臭名昭著的連續殺人犯而被捕，他唯一能求助的人，只有新手律師王泥喜法介。
可王泥喜能勝任嗎？他能獨自找到真相嗎？最重要的是，他能直面真相嗎？
準備迎接一段錯綜複雜到令人瞠目的劇情，其中充滿懸念和出人意料的轉折！

[摘自[url=http://forums.court-records.net/games/apollo-justice-case-demo-released-2h30-gameplay-t13200.html]Court-Records.net[/url]]
